sentences.l2: 元宵节前后，庙会与灯会几乎同时登场。
sentences.l1: Around the Lantern Festival, temple fairs and lantern fairs appear almost at the same time.

sentences.l2: 庙会多在庙宇周边的街巷里铺开，摊贩挨着摊贩，糖画、剪纸、泥人、旧书旧唱片挤在一处，叫卖声与锣鼓声彼此叠压。
sentences.l1: Temple fairs mostly spread out in the streets and lanes around temples, with vendor next to vendor, and sugar paintings, paper cuttings, clay figurines, and old books and old records crowded together in one place, the sounds of hawking and of gongs and drums layered over one another.

sentences.l2: 入夜后灯会接上班，成串灯笼沿着河堤与老街一路铺展，灯影在水面上碎成晃动的金色。
sentences.l1: After nightfall the lantern fair takes over the shift, and strings of lanterns spread all the way along the river embankment and the old street, their reflections breaking into shimmering gold on the water.

sentences.l2: 人们最惦记的往往是猜灯谜：谜条垂在灯下，猜中者可取下换取一份小小的彩头，围观者七嘴八舌，猜错时哄然一笑，那份热闹便从一个人身上传到整条街。
sentences.l1: What people think about most is often guessing lantern riddles: the riddle slips hang beneath the lanterns, and those who guess right may take one down to exchange for a small prize, while onlookers chatter noisily and burst into laughter at a wrong guess, and that liveliness spreads from one person to the whole street.

sentences.l2: 庙会与灯会之所以被称作社区的共同庆典，并不只因为人多。
sentences.l1: The reason temple fairs and lantern fairs are called a community's shared celebration is not only because of the crowds.

sentences.l2: 它把平日各扫门前雪的邻居重新聚到一处，让老人向孩子讲述旧时的规矩，也让外来者在一盏灯、一句谜面前，忽然觉得自己不再是过客。
sentences.l1: It brings together again neighbors who ordinarily each sweep only the snow in front of their own door, lets the old tell children about the rules of former times, and also makes outsiders, in front of a lantern and a riddle, suddenly feel that they are no longer passers-by.

sentences.l2: 灯火终会熄灭，摊子也会散尽，但那种被人群裹挟着共同欢腾的经验，会成为此后许多年里人们对"过年"最具体的记忆。
sentences.l1: The lanterns will eventually go out and the stalls will disperse completely, but that experience of being swept up by the crowd in shared rejoicing will become, for many years afterwards, people's most concrete memory of the "New Year".
